summary: Legacy postage meter invoices billed to office finance account; redirect and refund requested
description:
Issue summary: Multiple invoices from an old postage meter vendor (Pitney-Postal Solutions) are being routed to the Palo Alto office corporate charge account (acct-ops-003) despite the meter being decommissioned earlier this year.
Impact: Invoices are posting to the central office finance account and may cause month-end reconciliation drift; finance team flagged 3 invoices totaling $412.
Environment: Palo Alto HQ office (floor 3 mailroom); vendor contract was originally set up 2019–2021 and supposedly cancelled Jan 2025.
Steps to reproduce / verify: 1) Check vendor billing portal -> recent invoices show account acct-ops-003. 2) Confirm with finance that these were received and posted. 3) Check facilities ticket history for meter decommissioning notes (ticket FAC-2025-01-11).
Logs / evidence: Attached invoices referenced as invoice_2025-02-07.pdf, invoice_2025-02-28.pdf, invoice_2025-03-05.pdf (these were forwarded to finance).
Desired resolution: 1) Stop further invoices from charging acct-ops-003; 2) Request vendor refund/credit for the three invoices; 3) Update vendor contact and billing settings to our central vendor-ops account or close the vendor relationship entirely.
Notes: This looks like a vendor-side billing configuration issue rather than internal coding. Finance prefers to keep the vendor but route billing to vendor-ops; facilities are open to cancelling entirely if vendor confirms charges should not be occurring.
comments: 2025-03-18 09:12 - Ava Martinez: Filing this after finance flagged the invoices. I forwarded the three PDFs — please advise next steps; tagging facilities and finance.
2025-03-18 11:08 - Ravi Shah: Assigned to myself to triage with vendor. Can you paste the vendor contact info? Also opening a short vendor check with Procurement.

2025-03-19 08:47 - Priya Desai (Finance): Confirmed invoices posted to acct-ops-003 on 2025-03-01 and 2025-03-07. We requested a stop-payment hold pending vendor response. Please include procurement and facilities in outreach.
resolution_notes: Pending vendor response as of 2025-03-19; finance placed a stop-payment hold. Procurement requested vendor billing audit and corrective invoice. Follow-up scheduled by Ravi for 2025-03-21.
